entries.zh: 兴兵，起兵；招募兵员、组建队伍
entries.en: to raise troops; to levy soldiers, raise a company of men
entries.notes: comp.a＝compañía；desuolbado 按 de solbado(s)（soldado 之 17 世纪 b/v 旧拼写）读，与第 14 条 compania desolbado 同式互证，不影响释义

entries.zh: 搬弄是非，挑拨；造谣生事、兴风作浪
entries.en: to sow discord and stir up quarrels; to incite disputes, make trouble

entries.zh: 暗箭；暗箭伤人，暗中陷害（不易提防的阴谋）
entries.en: a hidden arrow; a covert, backhanded attack, backbiting
entries.notes: 西语栏难通读（lacauaculta norabedon destiene），释义以汉字“暗箭”与音写为准

entries.zh: 诽谤，说人坏话；诋毁中伤
entries.en: to slander, defame; to speak ill of someone

entries.zh: 心绪，心思；撩动心绪、动心起念
entries.en: thoughts, state of mind; to stir up thoughts or intentions

entries.zh: 驾祸＝嫁祸，把灾祸罪责推给别人；诿过于人
entries.en: to shift calamity or blame onto another; to lay false guilt on someone

entries.zh: 挑起争端，寻衅打架；引起纠纷
entries.en: to stir up a quarrel or fight; to provoke trouble
entries.notes: “间架”取方言“打间架＝聚众斗殴”义，据本页 levantar falso 词族（是非/暗箭/谤说/生话）推定，非字面“间架结构”义

entries.zh: 使心绪＝撩拨心绪，使人动心；引诱、挑动
entries.en: to stir or move someone's mind; to tempt, sway, incite

entries.zh: 使暗箭＝暗箭伤人，暗中加害；放冷箭
entries.en: to shoot a hidden arrow; to strike covertly, stab in the back

entries.zh: 生话＝造谣生事，编造言语；无端生事
entries.en: to fabricate talk; to invent stories, spread rumors

entries.zh: 举，抬起；提出、举荐；举发
entries.en: to lift, raise; to put forward, nominate; to cite

entries.zh: 令旗，号旗；（军队、官府）发号施令之旗，升旗发号
entries.en: a command or signal banner; to raise the banner (levantar la bandera)

entries.zh: 拾得，捡到；拾取所遇之物
entries.en: to pick up and take what is found; to gather up

entries.zh: 招兵，招募兵员；纠集队伍
entries.en: to recruit soldiers; to muster a company of men

entries.zh: 绵：丝绵；绵延相连、连续不断
entries.en: silk floss; continuous, unbroken (joined without break)
entries.notes: 西语栏难通读（cstarguntas o denadas），音写栏尾部混入西语残词（faxea/ordinaxia），释义依“綿”字本义（丝绵/绵延）与西语 juntar 大意

entries.zh: 沙坦，沙洲；水中或海滨淤积的平沙地（“坛”字存疑）
entries.en: a sandbank, shoal; a flat of deposited sand (character uncertain: 坛/坦)
entries.notes: 汉字栏注 [疑:坛/坦]，据西语 banco de arena（沙洲）定为沙坦/沙洲义

entries.zh: 用灰浆把石头砌合，和灰垒石（砌筑抹灰）；第三字存疑
entries.en: to join stones with lime mortar (mixed with a hoe); masonry, plastering with lime
entries.notes: 汉字栏注 [疑:墋/壓]，据西语 juntar la piedra con açadon（azadón＝锄，用锄砌石）与“灰做”定为灰浆砌石义

entries.zh: 释义存疑：字面“猫猫”（猫），西语栏却作“与窗门相合（关合窗门）”解，四栏不合
entries.en: uncertain: literally "cat-cat" (cat), but the Spanish reads "to join with the window shutters"; the senses do not reconcile
entries.notes: 四栏冲突：西语指关合窗门，汉字“貓貓”与音写均难与之对应，语义无法定夺

entries.zh: 配合，婚配；男女结为婚姻
entries.en: to be joined in marriage; to pair, match as husband and wife

entries.zh: 会合，相聚聚合；此处指婚姻结合、结为夫妇
entries.en: to meet and join together; here, to be united in marriage
